en.answer:

en.question: I have activated <<7344>>'s『if this card is Special Summoned: Toss a coin』effect. If, due to some other effect resolving in response, <<7344>> no longer exists face-up in the Monster Zone by the time its effect resolves, do I still toss a coin?
en.title: If <<7344>> is no longer face-up in the Monster Zone when its effect resolves, do I still toss a coin?
